title: Automate changelog/release-notes and onboard nova-tera-13b-v1.0 (perf profiles + metadata)
author: Liam O'Connor
description:
Motivation: onboarding nova-tera-13b-v1.0 into the model registry with production-ready metadata and performance profiles, and add automation to generate formatted changelog/release notes entries during model onboarding. This PR bundles three coordinated changes: 1) model metadata + manifest for nova-tera-13b-v1.0, 2) automated perf profile ingestion (benchmarks + artifacts), and 3) changelog/release-notes automation that produces a curated release entry and attaches it to the model release pipeline.

Summary of changes: added model manifest (yaml/json) with versioned schema, inference-cost estimates, recommended quantization profiles, and validated sample prompts. Introduced perf profile JSON files (throughput/latency/cost) generated from perf-canary runs and a small helper to normalize profile schema. Implemented a new changelog generator that: - collects metadata from the model manifest and perf profiles, - formats a release-note markdown snippet following the registry conventions, - appends entries to the changelog index used by the release automation.

Checklist: - [x] Model manifest (metadata + schema) added and schema-unit tests updated - [x] Performance profiles added (p95/p50 throughput, token/sec, mem usage) - [x] Changelog/release-note generator implemented and unit-tested - [x] End-to-end smoke test against perf-canary artifacts - [x] Docs updates: registry onboarding guide + changelog format example - [x] CI green after rerun

Migration notes: Existing registry consumers are unaffected by new fields (all additions are backward-compatible). The changelog generator lives behind a feature flag (env REGISTRY_CHANGELOG_AUTOMATION=true) which will be enabled for the release pipeline after ops validation. No runtime serving changes.

Why bundled: onboarding requires both perf metadata and a consumer-friendly release note for product/marketing; automating the release-note generation reduces manual steps and ensures consistency across onboarded models.

release_notes: Onboarded nova-tera-13b v1.0 to the model registry with curated metadata and performance profiles. Added automated changelog/release-note generation for model releases (disabled by default, opt-in via REGISTRY_CHANGELOG_AUTOMATION).
